rationale: shared.state introduces the identities, storage tables and reference/slot domains used here. This unit defines allocated, live and WF_Delta(S) before the later results. Allocated checks membership in object-table keys. Live starts at an initialized variable and extends through an existing object's initialized field, with neither constructor testing mode. References enumerates target identities from all initialized variable/field slots, and Owners enumerates reference occurrences in the same order. WellFormed requires Nodup object and variable keys; an existing declared class with exact ordered field shape and no duplicate fields; identities below nextId; strictly older field targets; Pairwise Compatible owners; and stored-target membership iff allocation. Compatible permits equal targets only when both modes are shared. This matches each bullet, including occurrence counting: two identical shared reference values in different slots remain two owners, while a unique reference excludes every other incoming owner. The older-target condition is a strict rank condition excluding cycles; it does not confuse a locally unique stored reference with globally unique path access.
